pages.title: Equip for the fight
pages.text: The Energy Sabre is a strong melee weapon. The Enhanced Energy Sabre adds fuel and module controls.$(br2)Hold the enhanced sabre in your main hand and use the armor configuration key to install and enable its modules. Supply both dusts just as you would for armor.

pages.title: Sabre upgrades
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Power$(): stronger attacks; usage 30.$(li)$(item)Inhibit$(): strips beneficial effects and suppresses Master Soldier regeneration; usage 30.$(li)$(item)Looting$(): better drops; usage 20.$(li)$(item)Fire$(): ignites targets; usage 30.$(br2)Check durability as well as fuel.
An Energy Sabre surrounded by Lithium Ingots can be upgraded at a crafting table. A blueprint is another route to the enhanced weapon.
